limitations: Provider labels are synthetic host normalization, not live Gmail/iCloud response schema

Profile resolver is injected in memory; no persistent secret storage or enrollment

Only seven pinned fixtures; oracle matching is not generic document completeness
Cleanup failure isolation and remote deployment acceptance remain outside this local slice
